description.value: The Cove Lakeside Resort is a full-service lakefront resort on Okanagan Lake in West Kelowna, offering spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom condo-style suites with fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, and private balconies. The resort features two seasonal outdoor pools, hot tubs, a spa, tennis and pickleball courts, and direct waterfront access with paddleboards and boat rentals. Its location near West Kelowna wineries and within a short ride of grocery stores and downtown amenities makes it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides detailed suite and amenity information. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site; however, in-suite laundry is confirmed across all suite descriptions, complimentary Wi-Fi is confirmed both on the amenities page and in OSM tags, a nearby grocery is referenced in a guest review quoted on the front page, and an on-site restaurant is confirmed via the Spring Suite Escape package description. The OSM community field says 'Kelowna' but the website consistently identifies the property as being in West Kelowna, which is a separate municipality.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Kelowna' but the website consistently identifies the property's location as 'West Kelowna', which is a separate municipality. The OSM record may be miscategorized by community.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly bookable lakefront resort with confirmed amenities relevant to touring cyclists. No grounds for exclusion.

Laundry.detail: In-suite washer and dryer confirmed in all suite types (one-, two-, and three-bedroom descriptions)

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant confirmed via Spring Suite Escape package: 'complimentary $50 gift card to spend at the restaurant or spa.'

Nearby grocery.detail: Guest review quoted on front page references 'grocery stores to fill your kitchen during your stay' as central to the West Kelowna location

wow_evidence: full-service lakefront resort on Okanagan Lake... two seasonal outdoor pools, hot tubs, a spa

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Nightly rates $219-479 CAD (~$160-350 USD); upscale resort with spa, restaurant, gourmet kitchens
